definitions.explanation: A general term for musical instruments of Western origin (piano, violin, guitar, etc.), used in contrast to {和楽器|わがっき} (traditional Japanese instruments).

examples.japanese: ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洋楽器|ようがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The piano is one of the Western instruments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洋楽器|ようがっき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{和楽器|わがっき}→和楽器：05231_wagakki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Both Western and Japanese instruments were on display in the shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音楽室|おんがくしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さまざまな{洋楽器|ようがっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧そろって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The school's music room is stocked with a variety of Western instruments.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧ (Western) + ⟦{楽器|がっき}→楽器：13159_gakki⟧ (musical instrument). Almost always used as a contrast term with ⟦{和楽器|わがっき}→和楽器：05231_wagakki⟧ (Japanese instruments). The same ⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧〜 / {和|わ}〜 pattern shows up in ⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧/⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧, ⟦{洋室|ようしつ}→洋室：15741_youshitsu⟧/⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋楽器|ようがっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}する→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧: to play a Western instrument
- {洋楽器|ようがっき}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: Western instrument shop
- {洋楽器|ようがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧: types of Western instruments
